facts.fact: RMB Namibia, a bank in Namibia, announced on 25 March 2026 a seven-year N$405 million social loan to Telecom Namibia, the state-owned operator, for network modernisation and broadband expansion (NAMPA). Added by the parent: a private lender's money into a state-owned operator counts.
